one_liner: Leading ultra-deepwater driller recovering utilization and dayrates with $6B backlog, but heavy debt, dilution, and a pending Valaris merger make owner economics highly levered and event-driven.
base_irr_note: Set by mechanical refresh after valuation.json component proofs
key_assumptions: Mid-cycle normalized owner cash after sustaining capital spending is near $400M, not peak FY2025 operating cash flow alone
Long-term debt and capital lease obligations of about $4.9B at March 31, 2026 must be serviced before equity earns durable cash
Contract backlog of $6.06B at February 19, 2026 supports visibility but has declined year over year
Valaris merger (announced February 9, 2026) is valued at zero in base case until closing terms and synergy proof land
